lines.en: label sanadorm25:
: Sana, are you up to anything right now?
lines.zh: : Sana，你现在有事吗？

lines.en: : Sensei? Just...a minute, please!
lines.zh: : Sensei？请……等一下！

lines.en: I can hear Sana yell from behind her door.
lines.zh: 我能听见 Sana 在门后喊。

lines.en: Well, it’s not exactly a yell. This {i}is{/i} still Sana we're talking about.
lines.zh: 嗯，严格来说也算不上喊。毕竟她{i}是{/i} Sana。

lines.en: It’s more like the noise a mouse makes when you turn on the lights in the middle of the night and cause it to go scurrying off to the other side of the room.
lines.zh: 更像是你半夜突然开灯时，老鼠发出的那种声音——吓得它慌忙窜到房间的另一头去。

lines.en: Just...somehow even less intimidating.
lines.zh: 只是……还要更没有威慑力一些。

lines.en: scene girlinblackredux1
: Um...G...Good evening...
lines.zh: : 嗯……晚……晚上好……

lines.en: : Hey. What's going on? You didn't have to come out of your room.
lines.zh: : 嘿。怎么了？你不用特意从房间里出来的。

lines.en: scene girlinblackredux2
: Well...I was actually...on my way out already...
lines.zh: : 嗯……其实……我本来就正要出门……

lines.en: : Am I interrupting something?
lines.zh: : 我打扰到你了吗？

lines.en: : No, I just...thought I’d go for a walk tonight.
lines.zh: : 没有，我只是……想今晚出去走走。

lines.en: : Well, I graciously accept your invitation for me to come along.
lines.zh: : 那我就恭敬不如从命，接受你邀请我一起去了。

lines.en: scene girlinblackredux3
: I...guess there's no stopping you now...
lines.zh: : 我……想来现在是拦不住你了……

lines.en: : Just so you know, though...I don’t really have anywhere in mind...
lines.zh: : 不过先说好……我心里其实没有想去的地方……

lines.en: : So we might just...walk around in circles...or something...
lines.zh: : 所以我们大概只是……绕着圈子走走……之类的……

lines.en: : Wow. You really know how to have a good time, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 哇。你可真会玩啊。

lines.en: : I do my best...
lines.zh: : 我已经尽力了……

lines.en: scene girlinblackredux4
: I could always...leave you behind...you know?
lines.zh: : 我随时可以……把你甩在后面……你懂吧？

lines.en: : Being seen with someone like you might...cramp my style...
lines.zh: : 被人看到和你这样的人走在一起，可能会……有损我的形象……

lines.en: : Who taught you to speak like this? Because it sure as Hell wasn’t me.
lines.zh: : 谁教你说这种话的？反正绝对不是我。

lines.en: scene girlinblackredux1
: I think Rin might be rubbing off on me...
lines.zh: : 我觉得可能是被 Rin 影响了……

lines.en: : She’s also been...helping me get better at talking to people in her spare time...
lines.zh: : 她还……在空闲时间帮我练习怎么跟人说话……

lines.en: Well...that definitely makes a little more sense than Sana just suddenly thinking she’s better than me.
lines.zh: 嗯……这总比 Sana 突然觉得自己高我一等要合理多了。

lines.en: Rin is essentially Kumon-mi's resident expert at playful banter, so Sana’s in good hands.
lines.zh: Rin 基本上算是 Kumon-mi 镇上最擅长打趣拌嘴的人，所以 Sana 跟着她是找对人了。

lines.en: I just hope she doesn’t become a little...{i}too{/i} much like Rin because I'm not quite sure how I'd handle her calling me {i}homie.{/i}
lines.zh: 我只希望她别变得……{i}太{/i}像 Rin，因为我还真不知道她要是叫我{i}老铁{/i}，我该怎么反应。

lines.en: : So...are you ready to go or...did you want to stop somewhere first?..
lines.zh: : 那么……你准备好出发了吗，还是……你想先去个什么地方？……

lines.en: : Where would I even stop? Does the dorm suddenly have a gift shop that no one's told me about or something?
lines.zh: : 我能去哪儿？宿舍里难道突然多了个没人告诉我的礼品店什么的？

lines.en: : No, I...I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 不是，我……我不知道……

lines.en: : I'm just...trying to be polite...
lines.zh: : 我只是……想礼貌一点……

lines.en: scene black
The two of us set off down the road and pass by several shops closing down for the night.
lines.zh: 我们两个沿着路出发，路过几家正在打烊的店。

lines.en: Sana doesn’t seem eager to stop at any of them...She literally just wants to walk. That's it.
lines.zh: Sana 看起来并不想在其中任何一家停下……她是真的只想走路，仅此而已。

lines.en: Which is fine, I guess. I mean, I’m no stranger to going out without a gameplan in mind...
lines.zh: 我觉得这也挺好。毕竟我对出门不做计划这种事一点也不陌生……

lines.en: But the fact that Sana wants to do something like this with me is an occurrence I didn’t think would be happening for quite a while.
lines.zh: 但 Sana 会想和我一起做这种事，是我以为还得好一阵子才会发生的。

lines.en: Maybe that talk we had on the beach helped her get a little more comfortable with me after all?
lines.zh: 也许我们在海边那次谈话，终究还是让她在我身边自在了些？

lines.en: scene sanabench1
: Okay...we’ll stop here for now.
lines.zh: : 好……我们先在这儿停一下吧。

lines.en: : Finished with your weird, aimless walking plan?
lines.zh: : 你那个奇怪又漫无目的的散步计划结束了？

lines.en: : It’s...only weird if you make it weird...
lines.zh: : 这……只有你觉得奇怪它才奇怪……

lines.en: : What’s wrong with two friends going out for a walk in the middle of the night?...
lines.zh: : 两个朋友半夜出去散步，有什么问题吗？……

lines.en: scene sanabench2
: I told you during vacation that I start getting a little...happier once the weather changes.
lines.zh: : 放假的时候我跟你说过，天气一变，我就会……稍微开心一点。

lines.en: : And tonight is the coldest it’s been in a while...
lines.zh: : 而今晚是这段时间以来最冷的一晚……

lines.en: scene sanabench1
: Don’t you think so, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 你不这么觉得吗，Sensei？……

lines.en: : I mean...Sure, I guess. I haven’t really been paying much attention to the weather.
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概吧。我其实没怎么留意天气。

lines.en: : I’m not dying from heat exhaustion, though. So that’s definitely a good sign.
lines.zh: : 不过我至少没热晕过去。这肯定是个好兆头。

lines.en: scene sanabench3
: Yeah...it’s kind of miraculous we’ve made it this far...isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是啊……我们能熬到现在，还挺奇迹的……不是吗？

lines.en: : Through Summer, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我是说，熬过这个夏天。

lines.en: : Every time it rolls around, I think to myself...Sana...you’re going to go out and...do things...
lines.zh: : 每到夏天来临，我都会对自己说……Sana……你要出门……去做点什么……

lines.en: : But then I take one look at the forecast and change my mind for the next six months...
lines.zh: : 可我一看天气预报，就又把计划推到了半年后……

lines.en: : Does this mean you’re going to actually do things this winter?
lines.zh: : 那这是不是说，今年冬天你真的要去做点什么了？

lines.en: : Maybe...
lines.zh: : 也许吧……

lines.en: : Though...I’m not really sure what there is to do with my grand total of two friends...
lines.zh: : 不过……我总共就两个朋友，实在不知道能做什么……

lines.en: : How about karaoke?
lines.zh: : 唱卡拉 OK 怎么样？

lines.en: scene sanabench4
: I’ve heard some rather...unpleasant stories about how Ayane acts during karaoke.
lines.zh: : 我听说过一些关于 Ayane 在卡拉 OK 里表现的……相当可怕的传闻。

lines.en: I’m suddenly stricken with a traumatic flashback involving Ayane and some song she sung in Spanish.
lines.zh: 我突然被一段创伤性的回忆击中——Ayane 用西班牙语唱的某首歌。

lines.en: Maybe it’s best if Sana doesn’t go down that path after all?...
lines.zh: 也许 Sana 还是别走这条路比较好？……

lines.en: scene sanabench1
: I...wouldn’t be surprised if Rin was a good singer, though...
lines.zh: : 不过……要是 Rin 唱歌很好听，我也不会意外……

lines.en: : I can’t really speak to how good I would be since I’ve never really...done something like that before, but...
lines.zh: : 我自己唱得怎么样就不好说了，毕竟我从来没……做过这种事，不过……

lines.en: : How about you, Sensei? Are you a good singer?
lines.zh: : 你呢，Sensei？你唱歌好听吗？

lines.en: : Is this you inviting me to Karaoke?
lines.zh: : 这是你在邀请我去唱卡拉 OK 吗？

lines.en: scene sanabench5
: As long as you can keep it a secret from Ayane.
lines.zh: : 只要你别让 Ayane 知道就行。

lines.en: scene sanabench6
: Ah! That came out wrong!
lines.zh: : 啊！我说错话了！

lines.en: : I didn’t mean it like that!
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思！

lines.en: : I just meant...so we wouldn’t have to hear Despacito!
lines.zh: : 我只是想说……那样我们就不用听《Despacito》了！

lines.en: : Calm down, I know what you meant.
lines.zh: : 冷静点，我懂你的意思。

lines.en: scene sanabench7
: Guh...
: I really need to be more careful...
lines.zh: : 我真的得更小心一点……

lines.en: : I feel like the more I learn to actually speak with you...the worse I get at saying the right thing...
lines.zh: : 感觉我越是学会跟你说话……就越说不出得体的话……

lines.en: : Is that supposed to happen?
lines.zh: : 这是正常的吗？

lines.en: : I guess so. That sort of thing just comes with the territory.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。这种事是免不了的。

lines.en: : Ready for another lesson, Sana?
lines.zh: : 准备好上新课了吗，Sana？

lines.en: scene sanabench8
: You mean...right now?
lines.zh: : 你是说……现在？

lines.en: : You normally only teach me speaking stuff at the bar...
lines.zh: : 你平时只在酒吧教我说话的那些东西……

lines.en: : Now is as good a time as any. Please take note of this extremely vital information.
lines.zh: : 现在就是再好不过的时机。请记好下面这条极其重要的知识。

lines.en: scene sanabench9
: Give it to me.
lines.zh: : 说吧。

lines.en: scene sanabench6
: Wait! That came out wrong too!
lines.zh: : 等等！这句也说错了！

lines.en: : Just teach me whatever it was you wanted to teach me!
lines.zh: : 你本来想教什么就快教吧！

lines.en: : Right...well-
scene sanabench9
: The more you talk, the more mistakes you’ll make.
lines.zh: : 你说得越多，犯的错就越多。

lines.en: : You’d think that learning how to speak publicly would put an end to things like that, but it's actually the opposite.
lines.zh: : 你以为学会了当众讲话就能终结这种事，其实恰恰相反。

lines.en: : One of the biggest downsides to becoming a good speaker is that your mistakes become more visible than ever.
lines.zh: : 成为一个擅长讲话的人，最大的坏处之一就是你的失误会变得前所未有的显眼。

lines.en: : Once people start associating you with your linguistic skills, those same people will pounce on any slip-up just so they can feel better about themselves.
lines.zh: : 一旦人们把你的语言能力当成了你的标签，他们就会抓住你的每一次口误不放，好让自己心里舒坦些。

lines.en: : So, if you think your problems are just going to go away once you get the basics down, you’ve got another thing coming.
lines.zh: : 所以，要是你以为打好基础之后问题就会自己消失，那你就大错特错了。

lines.en: scene sanabench8
: That was a lot more detailed than a normal lesson...
lines.zh: : 这比平时的课详细多了……

lines.en: : You didn’t even ask me to roleplay.
lines.zh: : 你甚至没让我角色扮演。

lines.en: : To be fair, your roleplaying during that game you guys played over vacation left me a little intimidated.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，你们放假时玩的那个游戏里，你的角色扮演让我有点招架不住。

lines.en: : Which is strange because it was also one of the cutest things I’ve ever seen you do.
lines.zh: : 这挺奇怪的，因为那同时也是我见过的你最可爱的样子之一。

lines.en: scene sanabench3
: I...was hoping you’d never bring that up...
lines.zh: : 我……还指望你永远别提那件事……

lines.en: : I got so wrapped up in the game that I...didn’t even realize you were there...
lines.zh: : 我当时太投入了，根本……没注意到你在……

lines.en: scene sanabench1
: But thank you. For actually teaching me something today.
lines.zh: : 不过谢谢你。今天真的教了我点东西。

lines.en: : Even if your lesson was just...another cynical outlook on how people take advantage of others.
lines.zh: : 哪怕你这堂课只是……又一种愤世嫉俗的论调，讲人们如何占别人便宜。

lines.en: : Hey, at the end of the day, lessons like that are the ones that really matter.
lines.zh: : 嘿，说到底，真正有用的就是这种课。

lines.en: : You never know when someone is going to just show up and ruin everything.
lines.zh: : 你永远不知道什么时候会有人突然出现，把一切毁掉。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah...You’re a cynic...I get it.
lines.zh: : 是是是……你就是个愤世嫉俗的人……我懂了。

lines.en: : I don’t like what Rin is doing to you.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢 Rin 把你变成这样。

lines.en: scene sanabench10
: Heheh...Even I’ll admit that it feels kind of weird being so casual with you...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……连我也得承认，跟你这么随便说话感觉挺怪的……

lines.en: : If I ever start calling you...homie, though...
lines.zh: : 不过要是我哪天开始叫你……老铁……

lines.en: : You can execute me.
lines.zh: : 你可以把我处决了。

lines.en: : Thanks, Sana. I’ll remember that.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Sana。我会记住的。

lines.en: scene sanabench8
: Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: : You won’t...actually execute me...will you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你不会……真的处决我吧……Sensei？

lines.en: : Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: scene sanabench6
: Why aren’t you saying anything?!
lines.zh: : 你怎么不说话？！

lines.en: scene sanabench11
: Perhaps he has forgotten how?
lines.zh: : 也许他是忘了怎么说话？

lines.en: scene sanabench12
: Oh, how pitiful it is to forget.
lines.zh: : 噢，遗忘是多么可怜的事。

lines.en: : To let go of something you love.
lines.zh: : 放开你所爱的东西。

lines.en: : Especially something as beautiful as speech itself.
lines.zh: : 尤其是像言语本身这样美丽的东西。

lines.en: scene sanabench13
: I take it that the two of you know each other well?
lines.zh: : 看来你们两个很熟？

lines.en: A mysterious girl appears before us spinning an umbrella around behind her back.
lines.zh: 一个神秘的女孩出现在我们面前，正把伞在背后转着玩。

lines.en: It hasn’t rained much since I’ve been reborn here, so I’m a bit curious as to why she’s carrying something like that around with her.
lines.zh: 自打我重生到这里以来就很少下雨，所以我挺好奇她为什么随身带着那种东西。

lines.en: : Umm...he’s my...teacher...
lines.zh: : 嗯……他是我的……老师……

lines.en: : A teacher? That’s wonderful.
lines.zh: : 老师？那可真好。

lines.en: : It sounded like your lesson wasn’t going very well, though.
lines.zh: : 不过听上去，你们的课好像进行得不太顺利。

lines.en: : To teach requires participation on both ends.
lines.zh: : 教学是需要双方都参与的。

lines.en: : So why has the man beside you suddenly gone quiet?
lines.zh: : 那么，你身边的这位男士怎么突然不说话了？

lines.en: : Can we help you with something?
lines.zh: : 请问有什么事吗？

lines.en: scene sanabench12
: Ahh...So you {i}can{/i} speak after all...
lines.zh: : 啊……原来你还是{i}会{/i}说话的……

lines.en: : And here I was thinking that things were about to get interesting.
lines.zh: : 我还以为接下来要变得有意思了呢。

lines.en: : Interesting?...What...do you mean?...
lines.zh: : 有意思？……你……是什么意思？……

lines.en: scene sanabench14
: Oh?
: You want to know?
lines.zh: : 你想知道？

lines.en: : Well...you just...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你们就……

lines.en: scene sanabench15
: Hahah...hahahahahah!!!
lines.zh: : 哈哈……哈哈哈哈哈！！！

lines.en: : The end of days approaches!
lines.zh: : 末日将近了！

lines.en: : Before long, little things like these talks...the looks you give each other...will be naught but memories.
lines.zh: : 用不了多久，像这样的谈话……你们看向彼此的眼神……都将只剩回忆。

lines.en: : And all of the time you two have spent will be wiped clean.
lines.zh: : 你们共度的所有时光都会被抹得一干二净。

lines.en: : Like old ink being stripped from a dry-erase board.
lines.zh: : 就像白板上的陈年墨迹被擦去一样。

lines.en: : The dawning of a new age is upon us.
lines.zh: : 一个新时代的黎明已经降临。

lines.en: : But for what purpose?
lines.zh: : 可这是为了什么？

lines.en: : And why now?
lines.zh: : 为什么是现在？

lines.en: scene sanabench12
: ‘Tis not my place to say.
lines.zh: : 这不是我该说的。

lines.en: : I'm just a messenger.
lines.zh: : 我只是个信使。

lines.en: : What I can tell you, though...
lines.zh: : 不过我能告诉你们的是……

lines.en: : Is that you are not prepared for what has yet to come.
lines.zh: : 你们还没有为即将到来的一切做好准备。

lines.en: scene sanabench13
: Do you believe in {s}god{/s} {s}GOD{/s} {s}GoD{/s} God?
lines.zh: : 你相信 {s}god{/s} {s}GOD{/s} {s}GoD{/s} God 吗？

lines.en: : What does that have to do with anything?..
lines.zh: : 这跟现在的事有什么关系？……

lines.en: : It’s a simple question.
lines.zh: : 这是个很简单的问题。

lines.en: : Surely you can answer it...can't you?
lines.zh: : 你总该答得上来吧……对吧？

lines.en: : Yes or no?
lines.zh: : 是还是不是？

lines.en: : Hmm...interesting.
lines.zh: : 嗯……有意思。

lines.en: : Perhaps you'd rather answer something like this, then-
lines.zh: : 那么，也许你更愿意回答这个——

lines.en: : What waits for you at the end of the world?
lines.zh: : 在世界尽头等着你的是什么？

lines.en: : Is it something wonderful?
lines.zh: : 是美好的东西吗？

lines.en: : Or is it-
lines.zh: : 还是说——

lines.en: scene sanabench16
: Something sad?...
lines.zh: : 悲伤的东西？……

lines.en: Tears stream down the girl’s face and drop to the ground below her.
lines.zh: 泪水顺着女孩的脸颊滑落，滴在她脚下的地面上。

lines.en: They mix with the sound of her umbrella as it cuts through the wind.
lines.zh: 和她的伞划破风声的响动混在一起。

lines.en: These are the only sounds we can hear.
lines.zh: 这是我们唯一能听见的声音。

lines.en: Something is wrong.
lines.zh: 有什么不对劲。

lines.en: : Are you...okay?
lines.zh: : 你……还好吗？

lines.en: scene sanabench17
: Oh no...
: You don’t know...
lines.zh: : 你不知道……

lines.en: : How simply tragic...
lines.zh: : 多么纯粹的一场悲剧……

lines.en: The girl locks eyes with me, ignoring Sana completely.
lines.zh: 女孩与我四目相对，完全无视了 Sana 的存在。

lines.en: : You pitiful...lost soul...
lines.zh: : 你这可怜的……迷途的灵魂……

lines.en: : How will you ever find your way home?
lines.zh: : 你要怎样才能找到回家的路？

lines.en: scene sanabench18
: It’s okay...
lines.zh: : 没关系……

lines.en: : You don’t have to say anything...
lines.zh: : 你什么都不用说……

lines.en: : You’ll reach for salvation soon enough...
lines.zh: : 你很快就会伸手去抓那根救命稻草……

lines.en: : And when you do, I’ll be there to catch you as you tumble further and further from everything.
lines.zh: : 而到那时，我会在那里接住你，看着你离一切越来越远、不断坠落。

lines.en: : Sensei...what’s going on?...
lines.zh: : Sensei……发生什么事了？……

lines.en: : I have no idea...
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道……

lines.en: : Of course you don’t.
lines.zh: : 你当然不知道。

lines.en: : There’s no way you would.
lines.zh: : 你不可能知道。

lines.en: : Not yet at least.
lines.zh: : 至少现在还不会。

lines.en: scene sanabench19
She pauses for an uncomfortably long time.
lines.zh: 她停顿了长得令人不适的一段时间。

lines.en: Neither myself nor Sana find it in ourselves to speak out.
lines.zh: 我和 Sana 都没能鼓起勇气开口。

lines.en: : {i}You’ve seen God.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你见过神。{/i}

lines.en: : I can see it in your eyes.
lines.zh: : 我从你眼睛里看得出来。

lines.en: : Oh, how envious I am...
lines.zh: : 噢，我何等嫉妒……

lines.en: : To think he’d grace {i}you{/i} with his presence...
lines.zh: : 想不到他竟肯降临在{i}你{/i}面前……

lines.en: : And yet will do naught but {i}speak{/i} with me.
lines.zh: : 却只肯跟我{i}说话{/i}。

lines.en: : Should we maybe...call someone?...
lines.zh: : 我们要不要……叫人来？……

lines.en: scene sanabench12
: There’s no need...
lines.zh: : 不必了……

lines.en: : I see I’ve already overstayed my welcome.
lines.zh: : 看来我待得已经够久了。

lines.en: : I suppose I’ll just go back to hiding now.
lines.zh: : 我想我该回去躲起来了。

lines.en: scene sanabench13
: Farewell, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 再见了，Sensei。

lines.en: : May the path before you be lit and clear of callousness.
lines.zh: : 愿你前路有光照耀，不被冷漠所阻。

lines.en: : And, to the girl in the black dress-
lines.zh: : 还有，致那位穿黑裙的女孩——

lines.en: : Please know that he is happy now.
lines.zh: : 请记住，他现在是幸福的。

lines.en: scene sanabench12
: Until we meet again...
lines.zh: : 后会有期……

lines.en: scene sanabench20
The girl turns around and skips away from us, twirling her umbrella the entire time...
lines.zh: 女孩转过身，蹦跳着离我们远去，一路都在转着她的伞……

lines.en: scene sanabench21
: ...Sana?
lines.zh: : ……Sana？

lines.en: : What just...happened?
lines.zh: : 刚刚……发生了什么？

lines.en: : Why are you crying?...
lines.zh: : 你为什么在哭？……

lines.en: : I saw her tears and I just...
lines.zh: : 我看到她在流泪，然后我就……

lines.en: : I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: scene sanabench22
: I’m...scared...
lines.zh: : 我……好害怕……

lines.en: : The world’s not really going to end...is it?
lines.zh: : 世界不会真的要毁灭吧……会吗？

lines.en: : Of course not. That was probably just some lunatic off of her medication.
lines.zh: : 当然不会。那大概只是个没吃药的疯子。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t think too much of it.
lines.zh: : 我劝你别想太多。

lines.en: : I don’t want to but...
lines.zh: : 我也不想想，可是……

lines.en: : My heart is beating so quickly...
lines.zh: : 我的心跳得好快……

lines.en: scene black
Sana and I remain on the bench for another twenty minutes or so while she composes herself.
lines.zh: Sana 和我在长椅上又坐了二十来分钟，等她平复下来。

lines.en: I try to reach for her hand to calm her down but she swats me away and seems even more adamant about not being touched than normal.
lines.zh: 我想去握她的手让她安心，却被她拍开，而且她似乎比平时更坚决地不肯被碰到。

lines.en: Why was that girl able to make a huge impact on her by just spouting nonsense?...
lines.zh: 为什么那个女孩光是胡说一通就能对她造成这么大的影响？……

lines.en: And who was she talking about in the end there?
lines.zh: 还有，她最后说的那个人是谁？

lines.en: $ sana_love += 1
$ sanadorm25 = True
{i}Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]!{/i}

lines.en: {i}You walk her back to the dorm.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你把她送回了宿舍。{/i}

lines.en: {i}She trembles the entire way.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}一路上她都在发抖。{/i}
